statistics.inference_limit: Ten sampled task-world clusters, five per task. Percentile bootstrap intervals are approximate with this small sample. Models and repeated sessions are nested observations, not additional independent worlds. One primary 95% interval; 5 secondary intervals use 99% marginal coverage (Bonferroni family adjustment). These are the same ten M1 worlds with new candidate plans, not ten additional replication worlds. No equivalence or experimental-savings inference.
